claims: Mick Cronin is the head coach of the UCLA Bruins men's basketball team.
Mick Cronin has held the position of head coach of the UCLA Bruins men's basketball team since 2019.
Mick Cronin led the UCLA Bruins men's basketball team to a Final Four appearance in 2021, notes Wikipedia.
Mick Cronin [received] the 2020 Pac-12 Coach of the Year award, notes Wikipedia.
Mick Cronin is The Michael Price Family UCLA Men's Head Basketball Coach.
Mick Cronin was hired in April 2019.
Mick Cronin was head coach at Cincinnati from 2006 to 2019.
Mick Cronin was head coach at Murray State from 2003 to 2006.
Cori Close has served as the head coach for the UCLA Bruins women's basketball team since 2011, says Wikipedia.
